description: Unit tests for the CTObjectsExtractor component in the Chromium project, testing extraction and verification of Signed Certificate Timestamps (SCTs) from certificates and OCSP responses.

classes.name: CTObjectsExtractorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing certificate SCT extraction and verification.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test certificates and log verifier.

methods.name: ExtractEmbeddedSCT
methods.description: Extracts an embedded SCT from a certificate.

methods.name: ExtractOrdinaryX509Cert
methods.description: Tests extraction of a standard X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ExtractedSCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies that an extracted SCT is valid for a precertificate.

methods.name: ComplementarySCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies an externally-provided SCT over a regular X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponse
methods.description: Tests parsing SCT list from OCSP response.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesSerial
methods.description: Checks SCT list extraction respecting serial number.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesIssuer
methods.description: Checks SCT list extraction respecting issuer ID.
